description: Discover the best hotels in Gold Coast, Australia. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Fun-Filled Gold Coast Escape near Coolangatta Beach with Two Pools & Mini Golf Course
hotels.description: Feel the warmth of endless summer at this sun-drenched Gold Coast sanctuary, where family-friendly fun meets laid-back coastal charm. Enjoy seamless access to the Twin Towns Clubs & Resorts complex, home to an exciting mix of bars, restaurants and live entertainment. Challenge family or friends on the tennis courts, mini golf course or in the games room, then unwind with a swim in the indoor pool or sauna - or slow things down outdoors with a dip in the pool and a relaxed BBQ feast under the Queensland sun.

hotels.title: Gold Coast Glamour: Broadbeach One- & Two-Bedroom Resort-Style Apartments
hotels.description: Unbeatable surf meets unrivalled sophistication in the heart of Broadbeach with a stay at these self-contained residences, perfectly positioned in Queensland's premier entertainment destination, The Star Gold Coast. Every modern, light-filled residence is decked out with luxury furnishings, a fully equipped kitchen and spectacular views of the hinterland, city or ocean, perfect for a romantic weekend away - or upgrade to a two-bedroom apartment for a family-friendly stay brimming with opportunity for adventure. Head up to the building’s resort-style, 20th-floor pool for quiet moments in the sunshine, indulge at the luxurious onsite spa or venture out to sample The Star’s dazzling collection of top-notch restaurants and thrilling entertainment venues. A few steps further and you're in the heart of one of Australia’s most beloved beach cities - brilliant white shores and barrelling surf await.

hotels.title: Gold Coast: Broadbeach Resort-Style Apartment Luxury
hotels.description: Discover your home-away-from-home at The Star Residences Gold Coast, where resort-style apartments provide a luxurious base for your Gold Coast escape. If you can tear yourself away from your immaculate, self-contained abode, head to the sky-high swimming pool on level 20 and enjoy dazzling city views, or make the most of the yoga pavilion and casual eating areas. You'll be in a prime location to explore the many dining options available at The Star Gold Coast complex.

hotels.title: Family Apartment Escape on Gold Coast's Broadbeach
hotels.description: Dazzling sun-kissed coastlines and pristine white sand await when you escape to Aria Apartments - a family-friendly hotel perfectly positioned in the heart of Gold Coast's iconic Broadbeach. Tower over the glitz and glamour as you relax amid the glorious 'Broadie' atmosphere with a stay in a gorgeous, fully equipped apartment. Aria Apartments is nestled between The Star Gold Coast, Broadbeach Surf Life Saving Club, and Kurrawa Surf Club, surrounded by trendy cafés, alfresco dining, ultra-cool bars and an unmissable shopping district, offering an expansive collection of luxury brands. You don't have to step outside the property's doors to enjoy the magic, either. Aria Apartments has an impeccable list of facilities to keep you entertained, including a heated 25-metre outdoor pool, BBQ area, gymnasium, sauna and steam baths, and a 12-seater private cinema.

hotels.title: Self-Contained Gold Coast Apartment Escape Moments from the Beachfront
hotels.description: Experience the Gold Coast's most iconic and stylish holiday apartments staying at the AVANI Broadbeach Residences. Enjoy views over the glitz and glamour of Broadbeach in a self-contained apartment with a fully equipped kitchen, and marvel at the sun-kissed glow of the dazzling coastline, dotted with award-winning restaurants, cafés and world-class entertainment. A serene beachside setting meets an impeccable list of facilities, including BBQ amenities, an onsite pool, undercover secure parking and fully equipped fitness centre. Make the AVANI Broadbeach Residences your perfect launchpad to explore the beautiful beaches, wildlife sanctuaries, and bustling neighbourhoods of this enchanting part of South East Queensland.

hotels.title: Waterfront Gold Coast Luxury with Poolside Dining & Private Marina
hotels.description: The pinnacle of luxury awaits at Imperial Hotel Gold Coast. From the moment you lay eyes on the Italian exterior and grand lobby shimmering under the sparkling chandelier, you'll know you've arrived somewhere exceptional. Savour exquisite dining at Il Barocco Restaurant, take time to lounge by the 60-metre lagoon pool or explore the Gold Coast's many attractions - including boutique shopping destination, Marina Mirage.

hotels.vendor_name: Mantra Circle on Cavill Surfers Paradise
hotels.title: Surfers Paradise Ocean-View Apartments with Dreamworld, SkyPoint Observation Deck & WhiteWater World Entry
hotels.description: Stay in the heart of Surfers Paradise at Mantra Circle on Cavill, a flagship Mantra property at the centre of the Gold Coast action. The hotel boasts ocean views from panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows, while top-notch facilities include two lagoon swimming pools, one indoor heated pool, a spa, sauna and BBQ area. Beyond the hotel, days can swing from theme park thrills to sky-high views, with unlimited entry to Dreamworld, SkyPoint Observation Deck and WhiteWater World (subject to seasonal operation). The G:link tram stops right outside the hotel’s entrance, making it easy to get to every sight on your Surfers Paradise list. Head to Broadbeach’s glittering entertainment precinct, wander past the restaurants, shops and bars of Cavill Avenue, and make footprints in the sand at Surfers Paradise Beach - only a five-minute walk from your hotel.

hotels.title: Surfers Paradise Coastal Escape with Daily Breakfast & Unlimited Dreamworld Entry
hotels.description: Run away to where it’s sunnier in the heart of Surfers Paradise. This high-rise stay puts you just 100 metres from the beach and steps from the precinct’s famous dining, shopping and nightlife. Each modern room or self-contained studio offers sweeping views of the city, hinterland or ocean. Days can swing from theme park thrills to sky-high views, with unlimited entry to Dreamworld, SkyPoint Observation Deck and WhiteWater World (subject to seasonal operation). Back at the hotel, unwind by the lagoon-style pool with palms overhead, or rejuvenate in the fully equipped fitness centre, steam room and sauna. Savour delectable cuisine at Fables Restaurant and enjoy a relaxing drink at Tales Bar. This central Gold Coast stay puts the best of the precinct within strolling distance.

hotels.title: Gold Coast Escape near Surfers Paradise Beach & Pacific Fair
hotels.description: Seek surf, sand and sunshine at Oaks Gold Coast Hotel, where a prime location takes the spotlight. The famous champagne shores of the Gold Coast are an easy five-minute stroll away, with retail therapy at Pacific Fair a 10-minute drive from the resort. The glitzy restaurants, shopping and nightlife of Surfers Paradise are just a six-minute drive away, with plenty of family fun to be had at the nearby theme parks. After a long day of exploring, return to your resort and slide straight into the turquoise swimming pool to cool off - pure bliss!

hotels.vendor_name: Q1 Resort and Spa Gold Coast
hotels.title: Extended by Popular Demand: Sky-High Surfers Paradise Apartment Glamour with Unlimited Dreamworld Entry & SkyPoint Access
hotels.description: Experience the Gold Coast’s most elite and exclusive holiday apartments staying in Australia’s tallest residential resort tower at the Q1 Resort & Spa. Tower over the glitz and glamour of Surfers Paradise in a self-contained apartment with a fully-equipped kitchen, and marvel at the sun-kissed glow of the iconic foreshore, buzzing with restaurants, cafes and world-class entertainment. This incredible oasis puts the glittering lights of Cavill Avenue at your fingertips with an impeccable list of facilities to keep you entertained, including outdoor lagoon-style pools, a fully equipped gym with a heated indoor lap pool, a sauna and a steam room. Plunge into Surfers Paradise from this iconic Q1 resort and you'll never want to leave. Step beyond your luxurious retreat for legendary theme park thrills at Dreamworld with heart-pounding rides and magical experiences for the whole family. Keep the fun going at WhiteWater World (seasonal operation), venture further to explore the magic of the Gold Coast, or ascend to new heights at the spectacular SkyPoint Observation Deck for breathtaking 360-degree views that stretch from the hinterland to the horizon.

hotels.vendor_name: Q1 Resort and Spa Gold Coast
hotels.title: Sky-High Surfers Paradise Apartments with Onsite Spa & Complimentary Parking
hotels.description: Experience the Gold Coast’s most elite and exclusive holiday apartments, staying in Australia’s tallest residential resort tower at the acclaimed Q1 Resort & Spa. Tower over the glitz and glamour of Surfers Paradise in a self-contained apartment with a fully equipped kitchen and marvel at the sun-kissed glow of the iconic foreshore, buzzing with restaurants, cafes and world-class entertainment. This incredible oasis puts the glittering lights of Cavill Avenue at your fingertips with an impeccable list of facilities to keep you entertained, including outdoor lagoon-style pools, a dreamy day spa and a fully equipped gym with a heated indoor lap pool, sauna and steam room. Plunge into Surfers Paradise from this iconic stay and you’ll never want to leave.

hotels.title: Luxe QT Gold Coast Escape with Miami-Inspired Pool Area
hotels.description: Experience the magic of sun-drenched Surfers Paradise firsthand with a stay at QT Gold Coast, a retro-glam, designer hotel packed with all kinds of excitement and intrigue. From the luminous pool and the sophisticated restaurants to the indulgent spa, there is no shortage of wondrous experiences to be found within the hotel. When the time comes to venture further, Cavill Avenue is nearby, along with bustling Broadbeach and the Gold Coast’s famous theme parks, all within a 30-minute drive.

hotels.title: Gold Coast Fun-Filled Resort with Unlimited Dreamworld Entry, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: Endless entertainment awaits on the Gold Coast, home to this five-star resort nestled between sun-soaked sand and lush hinterland. Having earned a reputation as one of Australia's top luxury hotels, this resort has everything you need for a memorable family escape. Relax at One Spa or dine at one of the onsite dining venues, including Amici and Arakawa restaurants, while the young ones are looked after with kid-friendly dining, a waterpark, jumping pillow and playground. A 27-hole course rounds out the offering for serious and casual golfers alike. Step beyond your luxurious retreat for legendary theme park thrills at Dreamworld with heart-pounding rides and magical experiences for the whole family. Keep the fun going at WhiteWater World (seasonal operation), venture further to explore the magic of the Gold Coast, or ascend to new heights at the spectacular SkyPoint Observation Deck for breathtaking 360-degree views that stretch from the hinterland to the horizon.

hotels.title: Gold Coast Apartments Overlooking Surfers Paradise with Unlimited Dreamworld Entry & SkyPoint Access
hotels.description: Marvel at the glitz and glamour of Surfers Paradise from above with a stay at Rhapsody Resort, a beach-inspired all-apartment stay with all the home comforts and modern luxury rolled into one. Spend your days lounging in your modern sanctuary while admiring the vibrant foreshore, dotted with buzzing restaurants, cafes and world-class nightlife. The rooftop deck and garden offer a quiet perch above it all, with 360-degree views across the ocean and Surfers Paradise. This stylish retreat is your launchpad to iconic Cavill Avenue and the weekly markets that make Surfers Paradise so distinctive. When you've had your fill of the Gold Coast's myriad activities, make the most of your beachside setting and the resort's impeccable facilities, including BBQ facilities, an onsite pool and a fully equipped fitness centre. Step beyond your luxurious retreat for legendary theme park thrills at Dreamworld with heart-pounding rides and magical experiences for the whole family. Venture further to explore the magic of the Gold Coast, ascend to new heights at the spectacular SkyPoint Observation Deck for breathtaking 360-degree views, or slide and splash around WhiteWater World (subject to seasonal operation).

hotels.title: Gold Coast Studios & Self-Contained Apartments with Rooftop Garden & Onsite Cafe
hotels.description: Set on the world-famous Surfers Paradise and overlooking the sparkling ocean, this towering hideaway is your ticket to a comfortable stay on the Gold Coast. Each studio or self-contained apartment has all the comforts of home with kitchens, laundry facilities, cosy lounge spaces and private balconies, plus floor-to-ceiling windows frame sweeping ocean or hinterland views. Dive into the lagoon-style pool, relax in the spa or sauna, grab a coffee at Rhapsody Beachside Café or work up a sweat at the fitness centre. This sky-high haven places you moments from Kurrawa Beach and the Pacific Fair shopping centre, with dining and bars close by on The Star Gold Coast precinct.

hotels.title: Coastal Cool Rydges Stay near Gold Coast Airport
hotels.description: Step off the plane and straight into the glamorous Gold Coast lifestyle with a stay at Rydges Gold Coast Airport, located just five minutes from the domestic and international terminals. Walk just moments to golden Kirra Beach, then enjoy the very best of the southern Gold Coast with prime surf, cute cafés, craft breweries, and local marketplaces all within close reach. When you return from your adventures, relax at The Salty Fox Rooftop Bar or be taken on a culinary journey at Madame Za.

hotels.title: Gold Coast Two-Bedroom Luxury Apartments with Outdoor Pool & Complimentary Daily Parking
hotels.description: Settle into a contemporary apartment in the heart of Burleigh Heads, with city or ocean views, floor-to-ceiling windows and a furnished balcony made for taking in the Queensland sunshine. With self-contained layouts and plenty of space to relax, each apartment offers an easy base for a Gold Coast escape. Cool off in the palm-fringed outdoor pool, then fire up the barbecue for a relaxed dinner under the stars. With cafes close by and Burleigh Heads’ surf breaks, boutique shops and national parks within easy reach, you can spend your days exploring the coast before returning to your own private retreat.

hotels.title: Bestselling Sea World Resort for Ultimate Family Fun
hotels.description: Treat the family to the ultimate Gold Coast adventure with a stay at Sea World Resort, located on the glittering Gold Coast’s Main Beach, adjacent to Sea World. Discover adrenaline-pumping action and uncover underwater mysteries at The New Atlantis, Sea World's newest and most immersive entertainment precinct, featuring a host of brand-new attractions - experience sky-high thrills on iconic wooden coaster The Leviathan, brave the colossal currents of the Vortex and decipher ancient glyphs in The Garden of Cyphers. Little ones can make a splash at the SpongeBob aqua play area, while adults can unwind at luxury onsite spa Sea World Resort Relaxation Corporation. Finish carefree days at the award-winning Hatsuhana Japanese Restaurant, pull up a seat at Shoreline Restaurant for bites inspired by the ocean or soak up some sun at Boatshed Bar & Grill.

hotels.vendor_name: The Darling - The Star Gold Coast
hotels.title: Gold Coast Suite Glamour at The Star with High-End Bars, Restaurants & Spa
hotels.description: Spoil yourself with a stay in one of the indulgent luxury suites at The Darling at The Star Gold Coast. This award-winning hotel is mere moments from the bustling Broadbeach dining scene, chic boutiques of Pacific Fair Shopping Centre and Surfers Paradise Beach. All of The Star Gold Coast's signature dining, casual eateries and glamourous bars are at your disposal, and the plush Azure Spa & Fitness facilities and pool are conveniently located onsite for your relaxation.

hotels.title: Five-Star Gold Coast Langham Luxury near Surfers Paradise with Six Restaurants & Bars & Signature Spa
hotels.description: Soar to new heights of Gold Coast glamour with a sensational stay at a sun-kissed oasis just moments from the spectacular shores of Broadbeach. Luxuriate from the moment your experience at The Langham Gold Coast begins - bathe in two glittering resort-style pools, unwind at the spa and dine and drink across six world-class restaurants and bars, including the iconic Palm Court afternoon tea lounge.

hotels.vendor_name: The Star Grand at The Star Gold Coast
hotels.title: Iconic Five-Star Luxury at The Star Grand Gold Coast with World-Class Dining & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Embrace the beauty of the Gold Coast - where sandy shores meet unrivalled glitz and glamour - with a five-star stay at The Star Grand Gold Coast, in the heart of Broadbeach. This exceptional property is part of the Gold Coast’s entertainment destination, The Star, and is just moments from pristine beaches, shopping precincts and vibrant nightlife. Savour world-class dining across The Star's 14 destinations, including the acclaimed Nineteen at The Star or indulge in a tranquil spa treatment.

hotels.title: Back by Popular Demand: Family-Friendly Gold Coast Apartments with Unlimited Dreamworld Entry & SkyPoint Access
hotels.description: Family escapes don’t get much better than this fun-filled, two-bedroom apartment stay on the sunny Gold Coast, with unlimited access to Dreamworld, WhiteWater World and Q1 SkyPoint Observation Deck. But the fun doesn’t stop there - Turtle Beach Resort features a wealth of activities the entire family will love, including the Splash Zone Water Park, Club Turtle Kids Club, a mini-golf course, cinema, four swimming pools, an arcade and more. When you’re ready to explore beyond the resort, the golden sands of Mermaid Beach are just a few minutes away, while Dreamworld and WhiteWater World are approximately a 40-minute drive. After a day of adventure, return to your self-contained apartment, complete with a fully equipped kitchen, spacious lounge room and dedicated laundry facilities. Designed with families in mind, this is the perfect place for kids to be kids while parents relax and unwind.

hotels.title: Central Gold Coast Apartments Minutes from Beach with Restaurant, BBQ Facilities & Pool
hotels.description: Experience the best of the iconic Gold Coast with a stay at Wyndham Surfers Paradise, perched mere minutes from sandy shores. This high-rise haven is ideally located for exploring the area's world-class surf beaches and gourmet dining scene. As evening falls, retreat to your condo-style apartments to savour breathtaking views, unwind in the hotel's chic cafe and bar, cool-off by the pool and embrace life in this seaside town.

hotels.title: Gold Coast Surfers Paradise Apartments with Unlimited Dreamworld Entry & SkyPoint Access
hotels.description: The Gold Coast’s glorious beaches and spectacular skyrises await when you escape to Wyndham Surfers Paradise - a perfectly positioned, family-friendly resort ranked within the top 10 properties in Surfers Paradise on Tripadvisor. Tower over Australia’s favourite holiday destination as you experience year-round sun-soaked luxury with a stay in a gorgeous, fully equipped apartment. Make the most of onsite facilities including a dining precinct with a pizzeria and Indian restaurant, as well as the Lobby Lounge Bar & Café serving all-day dining and refreshing cocktails. Relaxation is taken care of with a heated outdoor pool, spa and fitness centre, as well as a shaded BBQ area with sweeping ocean vistas. Step beyond your luxurious retreat for legendary theme park thrills at Dreamworld with heart-pounding rides and magical experiences for the whole family. Keep the fun going at WhiteWater World (seasonal operation), venture further to explore the magic of the Gold Coast, or ascend to new heights at the spectacular SkyPoint Observation Deck for breathtaking 360-degree views that stretch from the hinterland to the horizon.

hotels.title: Gold Coast Luxe Self-Contained One & Two-Bedroom Apartments Overlooking Kirra Beach
hotels.description: X marks the spot for your new favourite family escape at X Kirra Apartments, perfectly positioned on the southern Gold Coast's sparkling shores. Each apartment offers light-filled luxe living and spectacular views over the shimmering Pacific Ocean or hinterland. Beaming above the shimmering sands of Kirra Beach, just moments from world-class surf, top-notch dining and Gold Coast Airport, this sophisticated complex will be your home away from home when exploring the region's extraordinary natural wonders and theme parks.
